name: Adiosa
title: Cataclysm-Class World-Pruner

skills.name: The Weight of Heaven EX
skills.description: Emits a 50m dense draconic gravitational field crushing lesser beings into red mist. Increases own ATK by 30% for 3 turns and drains 20% enemy NP gauge.

skills.name: Lethal Cute Aggression A++
skills.description: An overwhelming, intrusive urge to violently crush anything small or adorable. Gains 20 Critical Stars and increases Buster & Crit damage by 35% for 1 turn.

skills.name: Absolute Permanence EX
skills.description: Anchors Spirit Origin to the core of planet Lyozes, rejecting all erasure. Grants Guts status (Revive with 4,000 HP) and Invincibility for 1 turn.

passives.name: Black Glass Stride EX
passives.description: Dense Aethel crystallizes the earth underfoot into black glass. Increases Arts & Buster performance by 12% and adds +200 flat damage.

passives.name: Envoy of Dragon King Ixenor
passives.description: Increases debuff resistance by 25% and rejects existence erasure.

noblePhantasm.name: Azure-Magenta Ruin: Incineration of Aethel
noblePhantasm.chant: ⟨ Kz'vohl aethren... Purge the fungal rot. Ground to glass, sky to ash. Ruin of Ixenor... AZURE-MAGENTA RUIN! ⟩
noblePhantasm.description: Fires concentrated beams of magenta light that bypass physical durability, incinerating the target's Aethel directly and crystallizing the earth into black obsidian glass.
noblePhantasm.overchargeEffect: Ignores Defense buffs + Reduces target DEF by 25% for 3 turns + 20% Buster resist down

lore: An ancient draconic entity from the skyborne sanctuary of Aethelian, predating the founding of Aethelgard. Sworn envoy of Dragon King Ixenor, dispatched to purge the corruption of the Ebonwatch Dungeon. She walks in a relentless straight line, unbothered by obstacles or diplomacy, leaving a trail of petrified black glass. Motivated strictly by the structural preservation of planet Lyozes, she views mortal races as an irritating fungal infection—yet suffers from a lethal form of cute aggression that compels her to violently crush small, innocent creatures without malice.
summonQuote: ⟨ Vohl... Shaz'dor aethren. ⟩ ...You summoned this vessel? Know that I serve Dragon King Ixenor. If you impede the planet's preservation, you will be crushed like the rest of the weeds.
battleStartQuote: ⟨ Kz'rath lyozes. ⟩ Disperse or be pulverized into red mist. The Envoy does not negotiate.
victoryQuote: ⟨ Skar'na. ⟩ The fungal growth has been pruned. The planet's structural integrity remains secure.
defeatQuote: ⟨ Zhor... ⟩ You cannot erase what is anchored to the world... The Black Glass shall remember...
